limits: Own whole-world draw pipeline with actual current game WASM and ordinary produced/voyaging ships; no original executable/browser is launched.
Own map terrain/water classification, atmosphere preset, source actor rotation/motion and temporal presentation policies remain explicit adapters.
Movement uses the actual public cmd_context C_MOVE branch. Four-neighbour water endpoint search is a test input, not a native map/path algorithm claim.
Each visual update preserves save/hash independently; intentional ordinary tick() calls between updates move ships and advance the calendar.
Original native GPU packed color format, complete temporal FPU context/culling/corpse/cloth-shadow behavior remain unproven.
